description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) GRAVIMETRIC GRENADE (Solar Watch, 1 CP) — WP-C5. Fixture cus11e_c5_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE, P2 Custodes, round 2). Setup privileges: the Custodes detachment flipped (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, Trajann's Moment Shackle marked spent (its prompt is not under test), the Custodes unreadied (Martial Ka'tah not under test), straight to the phase under test (the Orks' Charge phase). Entering the Orks' Charge phase opens the new charge_phase_start window for P2; a real click on 'Use on Witchseeker Squad' (unengaged) asks which visible enemy within 12"; a real click on the Gretchin spends 1 CP: when the Gretchin declare a charge this phase their charge roll is -1. Then (setup: P2 CP 0, no Fire Overwatch) the Gretchin declare a charge at the Witchseekers and the seeded roll totals the dice -1.
